news.title: Sebi warns investors against WhatsApp stock tips. Here's how you can avoid such traps
news.summary: SEBI has cautioned investors against exclusive WhatsApp groups spreading unauthorised stock tips and fake profit claims. The regulator flagged astroturfing, overseas numbers, replacement groups and suspicious trading apps, urging investors to verify credentials and use registered intermediaries.

news.title: NCDEX launches NDEX and FINNDEX to expand into equity benchmarks
news.summary: NCDEX has launched NDEX and FINNDEX, two equity benchmarks tracking 20 large, liquid Indian stocks and 15 financial sector companies. Their multi-factor methodology incorporates market capitalisation, trading activity, beta and volatility, with semiannual rebalancing.

news.title: CreditAccess Grameen Q2 profit jumps fourfold to Rs 502 crore
news.summary: CreditAccess Grameen reported a fourfold rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 502 crore, driven by higher income, lower expenses and credit costs. Improved asset quality prompted upward revisions to profitability guidance, while assets under management grew 19.5%.
